name: ExaBGP
what_it_is: ExaBGP is a pure-Python BGP implementation that exposes an external JSON/text API so that scripts and programs can inject, withdraw, and inspect BGP routes without touching the FIB. It is used for DDoS mitigation via FlowSpec, anycast management, traffic engineering, and network monitoring.
components: async reactor (default in 6.0) / legacy generator reactor
decode subcommand for BGP UPDATE message inspection
measurement: JSON-formatted BGP UPDATE messages emitted to stdout (neighbor, direction, NLRI, attributes)
BGP session state events reported via API
decode subcommand parses raw BGP UPDATE hex to JSON for offline analysis
healthcheck script provides service health monitoring and route announcement based on probe results
configuration: Single configuration file (INI-like syntax, e.g., etc/exabgp/api-open.conf)
98 example configuration files in etc/exabgp/ covering unicast, multicast, L3VPN, EVPN, FlowSpec, BGP-LS, API patterns
Environment variables override config (e.g., exabgp_tcp_bind, exabgp_log_enable, exabgp_reactor_legacy)
process { } block wires external programs to the API via stdin/stdout pipes
neighbor { } block defines peers with AFI/SAFI, ASN, timers, and capabilities
fault_injection: Route withdrawal via API (announce/withdraw commands over stdin pipe to external process)
FlowSpec rules for traffic rate-limiting, discard, or redirect (DDoS mitigation use case)
healthcheck script can withdraw routes on probe failure to trigger failover
silence-ack API command disables ACK messages to test programs that do not handle them
modes: server mode (default): runs BGP daemon from a config file
cli mode: interactive command-line interface to a running daemon
decode mode: offline BGP UPDATE hex message parser
healthcheck mode: built-in health probe with automatic route announcement/withdrawal
validate mode: config file syntax validation without starting the daemon
async reactor mode (default in 6.0, async/await event loop)
legacy reactor mode (generator-based, set via exabgp_reactor_legacy=true)
constraints: Does NOT manipulate the FIB — ExaBGP is a BGP speaker only; a separate dataplane (e.g., BIRD, FRRouting, Linux kernel) is needed if FIB changes are required
Python 3.12+ required for the 6.0/main branch; Python 3.8+ for the stable 5.0 branch
API communication is stdin/stdout-based; external programs must handle or suppress ACK messages (use silence-ack for legacy scripts written for 3.4)
No built-in GUI or web interface — all interaction is via config file, CLI pipe, or external process API
ulimit -n must be >= 64000 for running the full functional test suite
docker_services: ghcr.io/exa-networks/exabgp:latest — official image, exposes port 179 (BGP), mounts /etc/exabgp for config; no docker-compose file in the repo
notable_absences: No docker-compose file in the repository
No built-in route reflector or full-table RIB — ExaBGP is a BGP edge tool, not a full-featured router daemon
No OSPF, ISIS, or IGP support — BGP only
No NETCONF/YANG or gRPC interface — API is stdin/stdout JSON/text only
